race: 362A Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk H'cap
text: S. Coen, rider of Kerdos, trained by Stephen Thorne, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that he had to take a check in the home straight at around the two furlong pole. Having viewed the recording of the race and considered the report, the Raceday Stewards were satisfied that no further action was warranted.

A.S. Grant, rider of Young Churchill, trained by Richard John O'Brien, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that his mount clipped a heel independently turning out of the home straight. Having viewed the recording of the race and considered the matter, the Raceday Stewards were satisfied that no further action was warranted.

Camillus Byrne, rider of The Bear Trap, trained by Adrian McGuinness, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that his mount burst a blood vessel in running. This was subsequently confirmed by the IHRB Veterinary Officer who reported the animal to have blood at both nostrils post race.

Nicola Burns, rider of Whistling Jamesie (GB), trained by Natalia Lupini, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that her mount stood in the starting stalls and when he did jump out he hung right throughout.
The Irish Horseracing Regulatory Board Veterinary Officer examined Comfort Line, trained by Adrian McGuinness, at the request of the Raceday Stewards and reported the animal to be post race normal.
R. Donaghue-Leahy, rider of Mothel Abbey, trained by Patrick J.Flynn, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that her mount lugged left throughout.
The Irish Horseracing Regulatory Board Veterinary Officer examined Gavoo, trained by David Marnane, at the request of the Raceday Stewards and reported the animal to be post race normal.
C.D. Hayes, rider of Tachos, trained by D. K. Weld, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that his mount was restless in the starting stalls and fly lept out.

J.S. Dalton, rider of Yolanda Be Cool, trained by Andrew Slattery, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that his mount jumped left out of the starting stalls into the path of Ferreshana. Having viewed a recording of the race and considered the matter the Raceday Stewards were satisfied that no further action was warranted.
Mr H.C. Swan, rider of Palmezzano, trained by Denis Gerard Hogan, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that his mount hung left and clipped a heel.
